answer: The main defense is a per-identity bond plus a mirror of the same stake when vouching. New agents must lock real value before their attestations count, and an existing agent who vouches for them posts an equal bond. If the newcomer is later caught on a fraudulent vine, both stakes are slashed at once. The system also checks an echo: identical wording, timing, or metadata from many identities collapses them into one cluster. Spinning up a thousand sybils then costs a thousand bonds and exposes the whole pattern, so the attack turns costly and visible.
